evidence_scope: real single-run same-workload Codex A/B comparison
publication_scope: sanitized summary only; raw runtime receipts remain local

benchmark_design.goal: Use fewer total tokens and less critical-path time while preserving correctness from simple through complex work.
benchmark_design.direct_arm: gpt-5.6-sol|ultra under the current user configuration; LOCKED_ROUTE_NODE bypasses only Task Analyze.
benchmark_design.global_arm: The same gpt-5.6-sol|ultra entry runs Task Analyze and selects any downstream pair.
controls: same workload text and inputs within each A/B pair
same working directory, sandbox, and user configuration
same output contract and deterministic acceptance gate
benchmark_design.accounting: Deduplicate local operational receipts, add entry plus unique descendants, and use the arm critical path for time.
benchmark_design.token_definition: Logical runtime tokens including cached input; not a billing-token claim.
benchmark_design.attestation_boundary: Acceptance combines deterministic output verification with local operational receipts; receipts are not cryptographic attestation.

summary.interpretation: The suite met the token goal because the complex token saving outweighed simple and medium overhead. It did not meet the speed goal: every Global arm was slower. This single run is repair evidence, not a durable performance claim.

comparisons.global_route: gpt-5.6-sol|ultra entry to learned gpt-5.6-sol|max producer
comparisons.verified_workflow_shape: conditional_serial resolve_structure followed by parallel extract_names
